text.en: Clients speak very warmly of the team, especially highlighting groomers Myrissa, Daniel, and Sophia for their friendly reception and compassionate approach. Pet parents appreciate that staff take time to soothe dogs and build personal trust over years of visits. A single reviewer felt an extra handling fee was unjustified, but overall sentiment remains exceptionally high.

Reviewers emphasize how patiently the team works with elderly dogs, anxious rescues, and pets with sensory sensitivities. Owners appreciate that staff do not rush nervous animals through appointments, allowing them to decompress and feel secure before grooming begins. Many clients note that even timid dogs leave the salon relaxed and in high spirits.

Pet owners are pleased with the quality of baths, deshedding treatments, and haircuts, noting that dogs return home clean, soft, and smelling fresh. Several reviewers mention delightful finishing touches such as seasonal bandanas. Clients highlight that pets look tidy and well-maintained across both regular upkeep visits and seasonal tidy-ups.

q.en: Does Hair of the Dog accommodate nervous or elderly dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers emphasize that the staff specializes in gentle, unhurried care for senior and anxious dogs.

q.en: Do the groomers rush pets through appointments?

a.en: No, clients note that groomers work at the pet's pace, allowing dogs time to settle before and during grooming.

q.en: Are additional handling fees charged for special care?

a.en: One reviewer noted an added charge when two staff members were needed to assist a senior dog with a nail trim.

q.en: Can clients pay over the telephone?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that remote telephone payments can be arranged when family members assist with pet drop-off.
